thread:
Lena M.: Quick design sync: users in testing keep missing the token counter and are confused by Stop vs Pause during streaming. Need a compact proposal.
Omar G.: Can we add a small sticky footer meter (Tokens: 42/2048) that stays visible? Also move keyboard hint 'Esc to stop' next to it.
Priya S.: Agree. For actions: make Stop primary but soften copy to 'Stop — keep partial'. Regenerate tooltip -> 'Regenerate reply (preserves context)'.
Lena M.: Accessibility: use role="status" aria-live="polite" for partial updates and announce when stopped: 'Generation stopped. Partial result saved.'
design-bot: UX-lint: stop button contrast fails AA at 14px; increase contrast or add border.
Omar G.: Prompt library note: placeholder should read 'Search prompts or templates'. Add keyboard nav and aria-pressed on favorite stars.
Priya S.: Action items: Omar mock sticky footer + token tooltip; Lena will draft microcopy variants; I'll prototype aria-live behavior and confirm no focus jumps. Review tomorrow 30m.
Lena M.: Thanks, uploading updated frames by end of day.
